method: 从2013年高参原图与建筑师档案现状图各保留22、18个原图像点，应用独立针孔相机朝向，在双栋之中直接取首个材质和位置。原始及两份真正解码网重复检验，记录全部命中与偏差。

profiles.scale: approximate metre scale, one metre clear opening and threshold z0.46

main_gable.adjustment: Separate wall plane and projecting roof front; main roof edges roughly 0.33m ahead of wall.

secondary_gable.adjustment: The smaller roof verge projects in front of its plastered face. Occlusion by the roof shadows the right half of the wall at both stations.

number_3.open_casement_leaf: 2 columns and 4 rows in photo Gao-08; the later view shows an updated leaf and canopy.

profiles.station_limit: The two cameras look in similar directions from the south end of the lane; elevations and depths remain approximate. The unobscured segmental head in the 2013 Sony photograph determines the gate appearance for the model.
